title: escobaria sneedii subsp. organensis
intro: Escobaria sneedii subsp. organensis, commonly known as Organ Mountain Button Cactus, is a rare and endangered species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is a small to medium-sized cactus with white or pale yellow flowers and is native to the Organ Mountains in New Mexico, USA. The health benefits of Organ Mountain Button Cactus include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides.
